card.name: Opportunistic infection lists in HIV immune reconstitution
card.fires_on: Punctuation or linking words (comma, 'as', 'for') just before cytomegalovirus in lists of opportunistic infections. Seen in immune reconstitution warnings for antiretroviral treatment.

modes.label: Comma in infection list
modes.description: A comma after Mycobacterium avium infection, right before cytomegalovirus.
modes.example: , patients whose immune systems respond may develop an inflammatory response to indolent or residual opportunistic infections (such as Mycobacterium avium infection<<,>> cytomegalovirus, Pne

modes.label: Linking word before infection names
modes.description: 'as' in 'such as' or 'for' in 'prophylaxis for' leading into an opportunistic infection name.
modes.example: with caution. Antimicrobial prophylaxis for Pneumocystis jiroveci ( carinii ) pneumonia and prophylaxis<< for>> cytomegalovirus (CMV

card.writes: It seems to push toward the start of the word cytomegalovirus (cyt-) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on small words and commas that come right before cytomegalovirus in lists of infections in HIV drug warnings.
